<script>
function bcToggleMics() {
  var hidden = document.body.classList.toggle('hide-mics');
  document.getElementById('mic-toggle').textContent = hidden ? 'Show Open Mics' : 'Hide Open Mics';
  localStorage.setItem('bcHideMics', hidden ? '1' : '0');
}
(function() {
  if (localStorage.getItem('bcHideMics') === '1') {
    document.body.classList.add('hide-mics');
  }
})();
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('mic-toggle');
  if (btn && document.body.classList.contains('hide-mics')) {
    btn.textContent = 'Show Open Mics';
  }

  // Safety net: the calendar is built when the site is generated, so if a
  // rebuild is missed, hide any month that's already over instead of
  // opening on last month.
  var MONTHS = ["january","february","march","april","may","june","july",
                "august","september","october","november","december"];
  var now = new Date();
  var thisMonth = now.getFullYear() * 12 + now.getMonth();
  document.querySelectorAll('section.level3').forEach(function(sec) {
    var m = /^([a-z]+)-(\d{4})$/.exec(sec.id || "");
    if (!m || MONTHS.indexOf(m[1]) === -1) return;
    if (Number(m[2]) * 12 + MONTHS.indexOf(m[1]) < thisMonth) {
      sec.style.display = "none";
    }
  });
});
</script>
